source: Venue guide for a city scene. Names and dates come from drugstorebeograd.com, Resident Advisor news 81854, boilerroom.tv/city/belgrade, nosleepfestival.com, clubber.rs and dated local guides, read on 5 October 2026. Embeds are Boiler Room's own uploads; titles were read from YouTube oEmbed and each id was matched to its session on boilerroom.tv (Ancient Methods and 33.10.3402 to the 2019 Drugstore sessions, Tijana T to the 13 September 2017 Klub 20/44 session, Marko Nastić to MAD in Belgrade, 25 May 2014). None is used by another guide (grepped). Daria Kolosova (h2UwuQxyBGc) is deliberately not reused: the Europe guide embeds it.
note: Images are Wikimedia Commons, licence and author read on each file page, downloaded to img/belgrade-clubs/ (webp, 1200 wide plus 320 wide, each under 300 KB), none reused from another guide: 'Sava river in Belgrade, view from Kalemegdan fortress.jpg' (Petar Milošević, CC BY 3.0 and GFDL) and 'Beogad - savski kej - panoramio.jpg' (darkobajic, CC BY 3.0). Rejected: 'Rijeka Sava (splavovi).JPG' is Slavonski Brod, Croatia, not Belgrade; the Big Barutana file IMG_3651 shows a museum interior. No licensed photograph of Drugstore, Klub 20/44 or Barutana was found, so the venue sections carry none.
